external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: A supplier that uploads compliance paperwork and signs in to the supplier portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: A category manager who reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the supplier portal and pushes supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: supplier portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.
processes.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

data_stores.name: vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in the organization's cloud account into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A supplier signs in to the supplier portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads compliance paperwork to the supplier portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: A category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it in the supplier portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: The vendor platform pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: Encryption is disputed: the source says the nightly extract is encrypted end to end, while the landing bucket runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: vendor platform
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS supplier portal and the documents stored there.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform. ... The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier portal presents a web interface because the source calls it a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the component as a supplier portal.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the vendor platform are confidential because it stores compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The store contains insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the landing bucket are confidential because it stores the supplier data extract, including supplier-related personal data.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives a supplier data extract derived from supplier paperwork and contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the supplier database are confidential because it stores supplier records derived from supplier data.
assumptions.basis: The database stores supplier records loaded from the supplier data extract.
